cases.sentence: Когда жители Ашдода встали на ___ рано утром, Дагон, упавший лицом на землю, лежал перед ковчегом Господа!
cases.explain: «другой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

cases.sentence: Вот почему до ___ ни жрецы Дагона, ни входящие в его храм в Ашдоде не наступают на порог, где он лежал.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

cases.sentence: Они созвали всех ___ и спросили их:
cases.explain: «филистимских правителей» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

cases.sentence: Но после того, как они переправили его в Гат, рука Господа обратилась и против этого города, приведя его в ___.
cases.explain: «великий ужас» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

cases.explain: «филистимских правителей» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
